questions.stem: Why does thermal decomposition stop when heating is stopped?

options.text: Because the catalyst has been consumed
Because the products have been used up
Because the reaction reaches equilibrium immediately
Because the reaction is endothermic and requires a continuous supply of energy

questions.explanation: Thermal decomposition is endothermic, meaning it requires a continuous input of energy to proceed. When heating stops, no more energy is supplied, so the reaction cannot continue and stops.
